## Freed v26.7.2500-dev

The locality and deletion contract, deterministic stability status, and bump serialize-javascript and workbox-build

### Features

- The locality and deletion contract
- Attribute renderer memory against a pre-hydration shell baseline
- Deterministic stability status

### Fixes

- Sync and update reliability fixes
- Release build and type-safety cleanup
- Registry test filesystem race removed
- Align Facebook group regression with local state

### Follow-ups

- The provider Gate 2 reaction with artifact-only authority
- Run the cloud CRDT merge in a terminable worker
- Send cloud IPC bodies as base64 instead of a JSON number array
- Bump futures-util from 0.3.31 to 0.3.33 in /packages/desktop/src-tauri
- Consolidate debt tracking in GitHub Issues
- Reverse integrate v26.7.2300 into dev
- Align outcome repair crash fixtures
- Prepare v26.7.1900-dev
- Ship the next-generation Friends Galaxy

### Downloads

**macOS:** `.dmg` (Apple Silicon or Intel, signed + notarized)  
**Windows:** `.exe` (NSIS installer)  
**Linux:** `.AppImage`  

> macOS downloads are signed and notarized for normal Gatekeeper installation.
